scheduling.description: continuous-batching | paged-kv | radix-cache | prefix-cache | chunked-prefill | none

supported_backends.description: cuda | rocm | hip | metal | vulkan | cpu-avx512 | cpu-avx2 | opencl | tpu | xnnpack | npu

supported_formats.description: gguf | safetensors | awq | gptq | exl2 | marlin | onnx | mxfp4 | nvfp4 | deepspeed-moe | ...

tracing_support.description: how far the engine's tracing/observability goes. none = no tracing surface documented; basic = process-level hooks or a single span per request; per-request = one span per request with correlation ids; per-phase = prefill and decode are separately attributable (the only level that can explain a TTFT-vs-ITL regression). unknown = not checked. See metric_exposure records for the individual metrics.

verified_negatively.description: true only when the ABSENCE of a capability was actively confirmed against a primary source. This exists because 'looked and it is not there' and 'never looked' are otherwise the same null, and that ambiguity is what forced an earlier slice to record a verified negative in prose. null = not established.

sources.description: source ids; each must exist in data/sources/
